scoring_justification: Full recompute from raw simulation is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; T0 compare agent's reported values to the paper's published numbers with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values per phase for inert_max, chem_acoustic_tstar, full_tstar, blowup_mode, pressure_tstar_phi125, pressure_tstar_phi5.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table III (inert max), Table IV (chem_acoustic_tstar), Table V (full_tstar and blowup_mode), Section V text (pressure_tstar values 0.45, 0.319).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly copied from the paper's reported numbers; no synthetic alteration.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual published experimental results that the reproduction must match; they constitute the authoritative ground truth.

outputs.description: CSV containing reproduced numerical results for the ideal gas model with γ=3: inert resonance max amplitude, chemical-acoustic linear resonance blowup time, full temperature-dependent system blowup time and mode, and pressure-sensitive system blowup times for φ=0.125,0.5.

output_contract.notes: The CSV must have one row for each φ in {0,0.125,0.25,0.375,0.5,0.625,0.75,0.875}. Numeric columns must be floats; blowup_mode must be one of 'Entropy', 'Left sound', 'Right sound', or empty. Pressure columns may be empty except for the two specified φ values.

steps.description: Compare each row/column against paper gold with tolerances; blowup_mode exact match; compute fraction of correct entries.
